'''Bassoons''' were musical instruments which could create low notes which sounded similar to the noise created when a [[puffer turtle]], a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]], exhaled air from its bladders.

The [[Xantha]], a musical instrument native to the [[Gorothite/Legends|inhabitants]] of the planet [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]], combined elements of a lute and a bassoon.<ref name="Goroth">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bassoons were first mentioned in the [[1995]] book ''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]'', a supplementary book for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]] written by [[Nigel D. Findley]].<ref name="Goroth" />
